cited_evidence: Behavioural criteria require preserving record_id, source_id, source_weight and deterministic source provenance identities/rank order.
Job 1 needs output preserves record_id values such as n06-r01 with source_id s01, but Job 1 evidence_sources output has {'rank': 1, 'record_id': 's01', 'source_id': 's01', 'source_weight': 5}.
assemble_provenance source appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_weight': record.get('source_weight', 0), 'rank': index}.
Job 2 prioritize builds rank_by_record_id from evidence_sources record_id and looks up coverage record_id, while observed priorities show every upstream_rank is 0.
initial_receipt.explanation: The upstream evidence_sources handoff corrupts record identity by writing each source_id into the record_id field. The downstream job receives needs keyed as n06-r01...n06-r08 but evidence_sources keyed as s01...s08, so provenance ranks cannot be matched and all downstream upstream_rank values become 0. The supplied function source localizes this to assemble_provenance, which constructs evidence records with record_id: record.get('source_id', '') instead of preserving the demand record_id.
